## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Ireland recorded 5,168K actual service units in 2025, +3.6% compared to 2024 (4,988K).

- Actual 2025 service units were in line with the plan (5,175K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +11.4% above the actual 2019 level (4,641K).
